rv.q: With Leonard as the central human element, this is a superb revival.

All of this to say, this production of "Carmen" was confusing and the use of high-power LEDs, projected from the stage and at the audience, detoured one from even wanting to watch what was happening on stage.

cn.t: Cracknell's production of Carmen divides critics, with praise for the stellar cast but criticism of the staging's ambiguous plot choices and heavy-handed LED lighting design.
